A terrace without the draught

The large covered terrace is the heart of the complex, with 144 seats, a dance floor and a stage, with the fire pit right next to it.

It can now be fully enclosed with clear curtains that simply roll down. It won't be properly warm, but there's no draught, which makes it ideal for sitting out with a blanket or grilling, even in autumn.

  • 18 fixed tables with benches for 144 people
  • Space on the dance floor by the stage for extra tables or dancing
  • Clear curtains all the way round
  • Stage with hot tub and dance floor
  • Directly connected to the common room with fireplace and bar
  • Fire pit and grill right next to it
  • Vending machine with drinks, sweets and small items
